name: Amphibian Conservation Fund
summary: Fund held in trust for its zoo and herpetology funding partners, paying for conservation, breeding and reintroduction, habitat restoration and research for threatened amphibians.

eligibility.rule: Demonstrates a positive effect on threatened amphibian species
Targets IUCN Critically Endangered, Endangered or Vulnerable species, or others with shown concern or survey need
Keeps the project within 12 months, unless an exception is requested before applying
Keeps the funder's contribution non-negligible relative to conservation relevance
Runs the project outside the US, Canada, New Zealand and Australia
Does not cause a likely negative effect on local or indigenous communities

documents: Up-to-date CV, unless already partnering with Stiftung Artenschutz or received a grant in the last 3 years
Support letter, if a new project partner

status.quote: Currently there are no open grant calls.

access.quote: Anyone can apply for a grant.

effort.quote: Forms need to be sent to Stiftung Artenschutz via email (office@stiftung-artenschutz.de).

eligibility.quote: The Amphibian Conservation Fund only supports projects that can demonstrate a positive effect on the conservation situation of threatened amphibian species.

The target species are threatened species of the categories Critically Endangered, Endangered und Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List. Other categories are possible if there is a demonstrable reason for concern or if surveys are necessary to clarify the conservation status of Data Deficient or Not Evaluated species.

Project duration should not exceed 12 months. Thus, funding has to be spent within 12 months from the planned project start. Exceptions should be requested before the application is sent and may be granted in specific cases.
Projects for that the financial contribution of the Amphibian Conservation Fund is negligible in respect to its the project's conservation relevance
Projects in the US, Canada, New Zealand and Australia
Projects where a negative effect on the local or indigenous communities are likely

after_award.quote: The final report and financial report have to be submitted the latest three months after the project ends. 6.3 After half of the project's duration an interim report has to be submitted.

documents.quote: Budget filled in Support letter sent by referee via email (only if new project partner) CV attached (unless you are already partnering with Stiftung Artenschutz or you received a grant in the last 3 years)
Support letter sent by referee via email (only if new project partner)
